crossRefs.note: “The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

people.name: Haggi
people.line: Son of Gad, grandson of Jacob.

people.name: Shuni
people.line: Son of Gad, ancestor of the Shunite clan.

people.name: Ziphion
people.line: Son of Gad, progenitor of the Zephonites

translations.web: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;
translations.bsb: These were the descendants of Gad by their clans: The Zephonite clan from Zephon, the Haggite clan from Haggi, the Shunite clan from Shuni,
translations.kjv: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:
